notes: - Why a reaction went as a text is now readable in the dashboard. When a real reaction can't be placed and the emoji is sent as a tiny text instead, the reason (SMS chat, no react button on the page, the emoji not in the picker, the reaction did not land) was written only to the server logs — which the admin cannot reach from the dashboard, so the oldest open question (real reactions never land; every reaction arrives as a separate text) stayed invisible while every other failure became readable in Activity. The fallback now also writes a `reaction.as_text` line to the Activity log with the emoji, the person, and the reason. Nothing else changes: the fallback text still goes out exactly as before, and a reaction that lands leaves no line.
